description: Grade a MartinLoop run across six dimensions — task completion, verifier health, diff discipline, regression risk, security risk, and reviewability — and return a scored merge-readiness verdict. Use after a governed run completes to decide whether the result is safe to merge or promote. Use before martin_pr_summary or martin_create_pr to confirm the run is merge-ready. Do not use to retrieve raw verification command output — use martin_get_verification_results for that. Do not use to review an existing PR body — use martin_review_pr instead. This tool reads saved run evidence and inspects local git signals; it does not modify state or contact GitHub.

file.description: Absolute or relative path to a loop-record.json file or run directory. Mutually exclusive with loopId and latest.

latest.description: When true, evaluates the most recently updated run in the run store. Mutually exclusive with file and loopId.

loopId.description: MartinLoop run identifier from the run store. Mutually exclusive with file and latest.

runsDir.description: Override the default run-store root directory. Optional.

name: martin_eval

regressionRisk.description: Whether regression risk signals were detected.

reviewability.description: Whether the PR body and dossier are reviewer-ready.

securityRisk.description: Whether security risk signals were detected.

taskCompletion.description: Whether the run reached a completed status.

grade.description: Overall merge readiness grade derived from the six check dimensions.

source.description: Resolved path to the loop-record source file.

warnings.description: Non-blocking advisory warnings from the evaluation.
